label: No Padding
description: No padding produces the most natural, body-following shoulder possible — the sleeve is set into the armhole so the jacket falls directly from the wearer's natural shoulder point with no added projection or squaring. Associated above all with Neapolitan tailoring and the spalla camicia (shirt shoulder) tradition, this construction gives the jacket an almost relaxed, casually aristocratic quality: soft, human, and free of any militaristic squareness. It demands a clean natural shoulder from the wearer to look its best, but rewards one with a silhouette of exceptional ease and grace.

garment.fabric: fine wool suiting with visible weave
